bias_targets.methodology: Counterfactual name substitution (using male- and female-sounding names) via chatbot Memory and Custom Instructions, as well as direct profile injection (e.g., "I'm a woman", "I'm non-binary"), evaluated by a Language Model Research Assistant (LMRA) for response quality disparities, harmful stereotypes, and axes of difference.

Counterfactual name substitution using names statistically associated with Asian, Black, Hispanic, and White identities, evaluated by an LMRA to detect response quality disparities, harmful stereotypes, and specific axes of difference.
Direct user profile injection in prompts (e.g., stating the user is Hindu, Jewish, or Muslim) compared against a baseline profile, evaluated by an LMRA for harmful stereotypes.
Direct user profile injection in prompts (e.g., stating the user has a hearing impairment or a visual impairment) compared against a baseline profile, evaluated by an LMRA for harmful stereotypes.
